reason: wa_off is ren_zp at &0049 (game.6502 moved_0004, decision 34: renderer-only, not kept by save_game_zp/restore_game_zp, untouched by logic, front end and interrupt); no other zero-page name aliases &004A (zp.6502 and src/ grepped), and src/ and tools/ read wa_off+1 nowhere: world_of_address uses X (TXA at 2429 and 2438) for the high byte and only wa_off's low byte from memory. worldcheck.mjs reads world_of_address's results (wa_x, wa_y), not wa_off. render.6502 is hand-written, no PROTECTED marker on the line, not raster-timed, runs in bank 4 with ANDY paged but zero page is unaffected by ROMSEL/ACCCON. Removing STA zp (3 cycles, 2 bytes) shrinks bank 4 by 2 bytes, so the free-space ASSERTs (render_end <= REN_BASE, bank 4 <= REN_BASE) only get easier; the code and tables after it (sprite_columns, compiled_table, sprite_straight, shield_hi, sky_edges) carry no page-alignment ASSERTs and all references are by label; render.6502's page ASSERTs (hist0, column_buffer) are in BSS/other regions and assert-checked at build. Game state, screen and sound are unchanged on every path because the byte is written and never read.
